title: Towards an Evaluation Framework for Explainable Artificial Intelligence Systems for Health and Well-being
reasoning: The paper explicitly integrates 'Legal and Ethical Issues' and 'Legal and Ethical Assessment' as a core, cross-cutting component of its proposed XAIHealth evaluation framework. It utilizes the ALTAI (Assessment List for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence) guidelines to evaluate ethical requirements such as human agency, diversity, non-discrimination, and fairness.
